bug_semantics: CWE-284 broken access control on IDURAR's invoice PDF download: backend/src/app.js mounts Express /download with no JWT middleware, coreDownloadRouter extracts a MongoDB ObjectId from /:directory/:file, and downloadPdf does Model.findOne({_id: id}) then generatePdf, streaming invoice/quote/payment PDFs that contain customer PII. An unauthenticated client who enumerates 24-hex ObjectIds can download any such document.
flaw_origin: The MongoDB-ObjectId-to-PDF sink was first written by human collaborator Francis Onukwu (onfranciis) in e968bc95b8a1098d25d47d62615c4dd15e721941 (feat: create downloadPdf), a reconstructable member of merge PR #473. Immediate parent 4d74cb369fd8ab6ee998e35f92e54bcb7af01d13 already called downloadPdf from the unauthenticated /download router (ef38c0f932e3413b766d87486292f8d4163f79a6) but lacked the handler file; e968bc95 is the smallest commit that first wrote Model.findById/generatePdf. The /download mount had been unauthenticated since f22dc173e4e5e89364c20b9b2289f078f1eafc8a (static res.download only). A two-day isValidAdminToken wrap in 2b7eda9d51a1071ae15427290c22f993b7865e61 never shipped in a tag and was stripped by 050af4c7a5e07d9db07cfc3ed4fdcbe5f3ca86f6 before 2.1.0; that strip is a revert of an unreleased mitigation, not the BIC.

reasoning: CVE-2026-72600 is a real published CWE-284 finding, not a withdrawn advisory. The described bug is unauthenticated ObjectId enumeration against /download, which on-demand generates invoice PDFs from MongoDB. That sink first appears when downloadPdf.js is added in e968bc95; the parent tree lacks the file, so the vulnerable lines are absent immediately before the BIC. PR #473 is a merge with four public member commits, so the merge itself is not the BIC. The pre-existing unauthenticated /download mount (f22dc173) only served static files and is a different mechanism. A later isValidAdminToken wrap was reverted before any tag, so 050af4c7 is not the first-write. AI is judged only from the BIC commit object: human author/committer onfranciis, no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with/bot markers, hence NOT_AI. No landed fix exists on master, 4.1.0, 4.1.1, or HEAD; the case is unpatched, with the concrete potential fix being the same JWT middleware already used on /api (as proposed in open PR #1487 / issue #1428).
remaining_gap: Unpatched: no upstream fix SHA on master/4.1.1/HEAD; issue #1428 open; PR #1487 unmerged. Confirmed unpatched object with potential_fix.approach and potential_fix.rationale is recorded in the unpatched field.

potential_fix.approach: Mount adminAuth.isValidAuthToken on /download in backend/src/app.js (the same JWT gate already used for /api) and change UI download call sites to send the Authorization header instead of window.open, matching unmerged PR https://github.com/idurar/idurar-erp-crm/pull/1487.
potential_fix.rationale: The JWT middleware would reject unauthenticated ObjectId enumeration before downloadPdf can query MongoDB and generate invoice/quote/payment PDFs containing customer PII.
